messages.subject: Loading Libraries Causes Incorrect Formatting
parts:
Consider the code chunk

```{r packages}
library(Rsamtools)
library(rtracklayer)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(LiblineaR)
library(moments)
library(gplots)
library(edgeR)
library(topGO)
library(parallel)
```
After gplots is loaded, the formatting is wrong. It also happens after library(topGO)

on its way to CRAN at the moment. If you do not want to wait for that,
please follow the instructions at:
https://github.com/yihui/knitr#readme

Or just use the chunk option message=FALSE to remove the package
loading messages.
